products.name: DreamBox Math
products.note: Found in the research for The AI Ready School; not independently verified. AI: Adaptive lessons. Use: Adaptive K-8 math. Who: Students, teachers. Student age: School accounts. Privacy: Not verified. Price: Quote-based through Discovery Education; third parties list $20 per student per year or $7,000 per school. Caution: Owned by Discovery Education since 2023.

profile_text.body:
Discovery Education's DreamBox site describes online math and reading programs for students, built around DreamBox Math and Reading. The company says the programs provide personalized, adaptive instruction so educators can scale differentiation, and that DreamBox Math and English are designed for grades K-8, combining adaptivity with scaffolded lessons and continuous formative assessment. The site states that DreamBox's adaptive software evaluates children's interactions and adjusts in real time, and it describes the product as using Intelligent Adaptive Learning. The site also says DreamBox was named as one of 2025's best educational technology and was rated STRONG by Evidence for ESSA, and it notes that DreamBox Learning's solutions are now part of Discovery Education's family of products.

The product record lists DreamBox Math under Education and Research AI, with adaptive lessons for adaptive K-8 math, used by students and teachers on school accounts. Pricing is quote-based through Discovery Education, while third parties list $20 per student per year or $7,000 per school. The record notes DreamBox has been owned by Discovery Education since 2023, and that privacy terms were not verified.
